events.note: The death record notes that Agaphia was a farmer in the nearby village of Hucisko. Check metrical records to see if her birth entry can be found.

notes: On her marriage record of 1835, her mother is stated as "Xenia Kozaczkowa," but in the birth record of their daughter Anna, Agaphia's last name is stated as "Sawicka," which could mean that her mother remarried to someone with the last name of Sawicka.
